title: Refund Policy Overview
summary: Refunds must be justified by billing error, service failure, or approved exception. Standard support agents can recommend refunds, but higher-value exceptions may require manager approval.

title: Travel Reimbursement Basics
summary: Employees should submit travel receipts within 15 days. Reimbursement applies to approved transport, lodging, and meals within the policy limits.

title: Password and MFA Security Guide
summary: Users must keep MFA enabled and follow the guided password reset flow. Security exceptions should not be handled through normal support shortcuts.

title: Equipment Request Process
summary: Laptop and equipment requests require manager approval and inventory confirmation. Replacement devices should include a short business justification.

title: Leave Policy Summary
summary: Paid leave requests should be submitted in the HR portal. Emergency leave can be logged retroactively with manager notification.
